title.narrative: National and local authorities present investment opportunities to key stakeholders (during in person consortia incubation workshops in each of the five countries)

5 in-person Consortia Incubation Workshops in the developing countries Domestica and International public and private financial institutions and investors are convened, and the project stakeholders present investment opportunities.
At the CIW, the green corridor options identified during the Pre-Feasibility Study are presented to the relevant stakeholders (typically 50-70 people) in the area of interest (commercial and public). Following this presentation, stakeholders are asked to vote for the corridor in which they want to commit manpower resources in the next phase, and which role they want to take. By doing so, the CIW identifies the corridor for the Feasibility Phase, which have the highest commercial interest and thereby the corridors which are most likely to be realized as actual decarbonization projects.
